test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

Many __**noticeable**__ people were present at the function.
solution: The correct answer is **"notable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"noticeable" **means able to be noticed or seen. (जो सहज ही दिखाई पड़े या जिस पर सहज ही ध्यान जाए, स्‍पष्‍ट या ध्यानाकर्षक) • **Example:** *The scar from the accident was hardly **noticeable**__.* • **"Notable"** means worthy of attention or remarkable. ((पर्याप्त रोचक या महत्वपूर्ण होने के कारण) ध्यान देने योग्‍य) __ • **Example: ***The area is **notable**__ for its wildlife.* • The correct word choice depends on the intended meaning of the sentence. • In this case,** "notable"** is a better fit because it implies that the people present were important or noteworthy. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Notworthy"** is not a word in standard English. The correct spelling is "noteworthy." • **"Celebrity"** refers specifically to someone who is famous or well-known (कोई प्रख्‍यात व्‍यक्ति), whereas "notable" can apply to anyone who is noteworthy for any reason. 168:Tc44, Here, the erroneous word is **"sovenir.**
